official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 cycle (award table based on minimum score in 2026/2027 final results)
official.status_note: The official page states the deadline for the International Scholarship & Merit Awards is 31 October 2026 and that the full set of documents must be received on or before that date, with all awards on a first come first serve basis.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Awards are limited to course/tuition fees only.
benefits: 30% Discount for A-Levels AAA, O-Levels/IGCSE 8-9 As, IB Diploma 34 Points & Above, or IB MYP 48 Points & Above
20% Discount for A-Levels AAB, O-Levels/IGCSE 6-7 As, IB Diploma 30-33 Points, or IB MYP 44-47 Points
10% Discount for A-Levels ABB/AAC, O-Levels/IGCSE 4-5 As, IB Diploma 26-29 Points, or IB MYP 35-43 Points
Merit Awards are awarded on a yearly basis and are renewable upon meeting minimum CGPA 2.50 at the end of each academic year
eligibility: APU Scholarships & Merit Awards for international students are available to new international students on first come first serve basis
This Scholarship & Merit awards is applicable to all countries / nationalities
Qualifying pre-university results: A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma or IB Middle Years Programme (IB MYP)

Applicants with Sports Excellence - Participation at International sporting events (Olympics, SEA Games, Youth Olympics, Asian Games, World Cups and Commonwealth Games) can be considered for the Merit Awards on a case to case basis
All Awards are applicable for studies at APU in Malaysia only and are not applicable for study at overseas partner universities
requirements: All Awards leading to fees rebate/discount are on a first come first serve basis and you may secure by paying Application & Processing Fees of RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950)
All applicants must meet the minimum entry requirements & maintain the CGPA of 2.50 in order to enjoy the Fee Awards in the subsequent years
All the Award Applications must fulfil the Award Academic Entry Requirements with actual results
We must receive the full set of documents for scholarship application on or before the deadline date
Applications will not be considered if the required information and/or documents are incomplete or not submitted

Award holders must practice exemplary behaviour and comply with the Rules & Regulations and Professional Code of Conduct of APU/APIIT, and must attend all required classes, lectures, tutorials and lessons
documents: Completed APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online application form (Applicant Name, Gender, Date of Birth, Nationality, Residential City and Country, Email, Mobile/Whatsapp, Course Interested, Current Qualification)

Educational documents / certificates - up to ten (10) relevant documents on academic qualifications, each file not exceeding 1 MB, file name at least five (5) characters, file types jpg, gif, png, pdf, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, rar or zip
Copies of IELTS/TOEFL etc to evaluate English Language Proficiency (listed on APU's International Students Application Procedure page)
IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET English Certification Results (listed on APU's International Students Application Procedure page)
selection_criteria: The award band is set by the applicant's pre-university qualification score in the 2026/2027 final results
All awards are allocated on a first come first serve basis
All Awards offered by APU/APIIT to any student are at the absolute discretion of the Scholarships & Merit Awards Committee
The University reserves the right to decide on the number of Awards to be awarded for each programme
Sports Excellence participation at international sporting events is considered on a case to case basis
coverage: Awards are limited to course/tuition fees only
10% to 30% tuition fee rebate/discount depending on qualification score
application_method: Complete and submit the APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online application form on the awards page
official.application_route: Online form on the APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards page, with the full document set received by APU on or before 31 October 2026
official.citizenship_residency: This Scholarship & Merit awards is applicable to all countries / nationalities; awards are for studies at APU in Malaysia only
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scheme is for new international student applicants of any nationality
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject or agency restriction is published; the application form requires selection of a Course Interested from APU Foundation, Diploma, Certificate and Undergraduate programmes
official.duration: Merit Awards are awarded on a yearly basis and are renewable upon meeting minimum CGPA 2.50 at the end of each academic year
official.description: APU offers new international students of all nationalities a range of fee Awards leading to rebates/discounts, with the band determined by pre-university results in A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP. The awards cover tuition fees only, are allocated first come first served, and are renewable each academic year provided the holder maintains CGPA 2.50.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship / tuition fee award (fee rebate or discount)

english_requirement - no minimum IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET band score is published; APU's International Students Application Procedure page lists English certification results as an application document without stating a threshold
study_mode - the awards page does not state full-time or part-time study mode
any institutional or nomination deadline differing from the scholarship deadline - none is published
verification.notes: Award bands, 31 October 2026 deadline, conditions of the awards and the application form fields were read directly on the official APU awards page; the document list was cross-checked on APU's International Students Application Procedure page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a tuition-fee discount rather than cash funding: APU rebates 10%, 20% or 30% of your course fees according to the band your actual A-Level, O-Level/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP results land in, so the grade you already hold decides the value and financial need plays no part. You secure the rebate by paying the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) Application & Processing Fee, and because allocation is strictly first come first served and capped per programme, submitting early is worth more than a marginal grade edge. Everything beyond tuition - registration fees, accommodation, deposits, partner university fees, resits, living and travel costs - remains your own expense, so treat this as a reduction of your total fee bill rather than support that funds your living.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International school leavers holding strong A-Level, O-Level/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP results who can pay the RM 3,600 processing fee and are set on enrolling at APU's Malaysia campus.
application_readiness_checklist: Identify your band from actual released results before applying: AAA / 8-9 As / IB 34+ / MYP 48+ for 30%, AAB / 6-7 As / IB 30-33 / MYP 44-47 for 20%, ABB-AAC / 4-5 As / IB 26-29 / MYP 35-43 for 10%
Scan all academic transcripts and certificates in advance - up to 10 files, each under 1 MB, with filenames of at least five characters
Budget the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) Application & Processing Fee, since paying it is what actually secures the rebate
Have IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET certification results ready to include in the international application file
Submit well before 31 October 2026 and confirm receipt, as APU must hold the full document set by that date
common_rejection_risks: Submitting an application with incomplete or missing information or documents - APU states these are not considered
Relying on predicted or pending results, when the Awards must be fulfilled with actual results
Missing the per-programme award allocation because applicants ahead of you took the remaining places
Failing to maintain CGPA 2.50 in a later year, which terminates or suspends the award
Assuming the rebate carries into a year spent at an overseas partner university, which it does not
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Registration fees, accommodation, deposits, partner university fees, resit or retake fees, and living and travel expenses are excluded and borne by the award holder; you also fund the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) Application & Processing Fee and any English test or document verification costs.
document_audit: Upload constraints are strict: each file must be under 1 MB, named with at least five characters, and in jpg, gif, png, pdf, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, rar or zip format
Certificates must show final actual results matching a band; predicted grades and school letters do not evidence the band
The form's Course Interested selection should match the programme you actually intend to enrol in, or processing can stall
English certification results are expected as part of the international file even though APU publishes no minimum score, so an absent test result can still hold up the application
alerts: 31 October 2026 is a document-receipt deadline, not merely a form-submission date - APU must hold the full set by then
Allocation is first come first served and capped per programme, so a strong late applicant can lose out to an earlier average one
Paying the RM 3,600 Application & Processing Fee is the securing step, so confirm your intent to enrol before committing the money
A CGPA below 2.50 in any later year terminates or suspends the award, and recipients who breach the terms must repay the total value awarded in full
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the embedded online form on the awards page, upload up to ten academic documents, pay the RM 3,600 Application & Processing Fee to secure the rebate, then ensure the remaining international application documents reach APU before 31 October 2026.
